$comment: Games that failed a depth rule when it landed, and why. Shrink only: remove a game's entry in the PR that makes it pass; never add one (games-design and games-depth fail an entry the base branch lacks). Rules: brief (PLAN.md design brief), from-zero (proofs/flows/from-zero.flow.ts plays a new game through real input), depth (the numbers that run measures). See games/scripts/knownFailing.ts.

beacon-bastion.from-zero: no from-zero proof; to-first-defense waits for the first wave rather than playing from a new game
beacon-bastion.depth: no from-zero run to measure; no content budget or unlock pace declared

deepward.brief: no PLAN.md design brief (DESIGN.md exists but is not the brief)
deepward.from-zero: no from-zero proof; depth-run seeds a mid-game record with deepward.dev.seed
deepward.depth: a dive is 110 seconds of air; 5 salvage kinds, 4 strata and 7 blueprints are the whole content

drift-foundry.from-zero: no from-zero proof; to-corridor boots into a run

ember-command.depth: no from-zero run to measure; no content budget or unlock pace declared

harbor-heat.depth: no from-zero run to measure; a 12-minute day and no declared content budget
